name: rendition
summary: A fuller long-form story in chapters: headline and standfirst, contents, setup, three chapters with a pull quote, a figure and an aside, what it means, and sources.
not_for: one idea on one page (use story)

finish_line.says: one H1, and it states the finding
links a kit tunnel holds (kit v2: kit.css and kit.js), so it renders in every viewer
no stylesheet or script from another host (the kit is ours)
every frame or figure carries its own picture, not a stock block (pages/draw-a-frame)
a fuller piece: 1200 visible words at least
read top to bottom, the titles alone tell the story; the first is the answer
Setup defines every actor, thing, number and rule before it is used
estimates, simulations and illustrative numbers are marked next to the number
works at 400px wide and in dark mode
anyone signed out who opens the link (mail, a website, an unfurl) can read it only if it was created with visibility "public"; the default is private and they get 404
